scope: Randomized variants of 15 requests that receive the external Power Infusion (validation/2026-10-08-external-power-infusion-sweep/*.base.json, the requests of the accepted external Power Infusion fixtures): the Fire and Frost Mage, the Destruction and Affliction Warlock, the Shadow and Smite Priest, whose own Power Infusion is talented in six of them, the Retribution Paladin, the Protection Warrior and the Beast Mastery Hunter, with 1, 2, 3 or 12 priests casting it on the player (individualBuffs.powerInfusions). 16 for each base at 200 iterations, with the race drawn from Human, Gnome, Undead and Troll for the Mages, Human, Gnome, Orc and Undead for the Destruction Warlock, Human, Gnome and Undead for the Affliction Warlock, Human, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead and Troll for the Priests, Human and Dwarf for the Paladin, Human, Dwarf, Orc and Undead for the Warrior and Dwarf, Night Elf, Orc, Tauren and Troll for the Hunter, each exported with the pinned Go engine and run by Go and Rust.
generator: python3 tools/sweep.py validation/2026-10-08-external-power-infusion-sweep/NAME.base.json --seed 20261008 --count 16 --iterations 200 --races RACES --output <scratch>/NAME for each base, with RACES as the scope says and --max-distance 5 for the Paladin and the Warrior; each variant <scratch>/NAME/sweep-XX.json is compared as NAME-sweep-XX.request.json
rerun: python3 tools/prepared_v2.py compare --output <scratch> <variants>/*.request.json, with the variants named as the generator says

criteria.comparison: full RaidSimResult except elapsedNs, lists keyed by ID
criteria.deviations: as variances at the scale of mean^2

notes: Every variant matches the pinned Go engine on the whole result and the first-fight log: all 240. The variants change the fight from 30 to 360 seconds, so the sources take their turns once, return after their three minute cooldown or are cut short by the end of the fight.

The external Power Infusion is cast in the first fight of all 240 variants, with two casts at least three minutes apart in 120 of them; the 12 source Priest variants put an external copy up when the priest's own comes off cooldown in 12 first fights, where the own copy takes the multipliers over from the external one and divides the other's out first.

The Affliction Warlock draws no Orc: an Orc Affliction Warlock's Death Coil heal logs the healing power it had at the reset once Blood Fury has raised it, which Go logs live, with or without Power Infusion (4 of the first 16 draws differ in that line alone, and the same variant with powerInfusions removed differs the same way). It is a log line only and unrelated to Power Infusion; a follow-up task covers it.
